question: Why would a dull-minded person serve those averse to Kālī's feet?
premises: Some are averse to serving the Mother's feet.
The dull-minded may serve such people.
The question implies this is misguided.
inference: Serving those opposed to devotion to Kālī is a mark of dull understanding.
plain_english: O Mother, why does the dull-minded person serve those who are averse to serving your feet?
